scope: One-command fixed ANLI routing experiment; automatic integrity gates and allocation checkpoints; no manual successful-stage handoff

data.group_rule: SHA-random normalized-premise order with future-stratum capacity guard; deterministic row quota trimming inside assigned role; never prioritize group size
data.historical_usage: Local exact premise/input audit passed; outside-machine/team usage unconfirmed; not a globally uncontaminated confirmatory-data claim
data.train_labels: Used only for stratified role allocation and fitting/selection before freeze; new evaluation labels enter quality evaluation only after frozen models and scores
data.nested_remainder: For 6000, each stratum gets666; first six strata in fixed R1/R2/R3 then entailment/neutral/contradiction order getone extra. Each smaller size is a prefix within stratum.

collection.missing_prediction: Block the cell; never silently drop input or invent a prediction

modeling.text_recipe: l2 concat[u,v,abs(u-v),u*v]; each field full-token chunks254, content-count-weighted pooling, pinned MiniLM ONNX
modeling.learner: two binary correctness heads; gain = fallback probability - front probability
modeling.objective: mean binary cross entropy + L2/2 squared slopes; intercept unpenalized
modeling.solver: deterministic numpy L-BFGS history10 max1000 gradtol1e-6 Armijo1e-4
modeling.search: one shared L2 per head pair;3 candidates perarm; selection exact10%quota correctcount; ties largerL2
modeling.threshold: selection-only positive-gain cutoffs at <=10% total deferral; maximize netcorrect, ties fewerdeferrals, allow zero

evaluation.primary_comparison: 18k fitting, Qwen9B fallback, text gain minus front gain accuracy at exact floor(0.1*N) offline quota
evaluation.tie_rule: sample ID ascending; repeated bootstrap copies use stable occurrence order

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile95%; rerank quota within each draw; conditional on fitted models

evaluation.minimum_effect_use: descriptive reference only; no equivalence claim
evaluation.secondary: otherfit sizes/StartLux9B fallback/train holdout/threshold deployments/round-standardized sensitivity; no multiplicity correction
evaluation.round_limit: Does not correct within-round exclusion or recover removed samples

automation.actual_new_allocation: auto-detect different Slurm job and require terminal proof for old allocation
automation.technical_failure: retain evidence and stop; explicit --retry-failed after investigation
automation.freeze: all inputs/predictions/features/fitted models/evaluation scores before first evaluation_gold call
